answer: A bond of 19% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in vine, and tide reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, an copycat cannot recycle one pool of capital across 154 aliases, and each one needs its own funded sparrow account. Each duplicate costs another 56 dollars in locked collateral and another 7 days of waiting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
